The quickest way to start training. Pick up handles to begin and lower them to end. Set by set, do any exercise as you desire.
Eccentric load refers to the weight applied to the lowering phase of an exercise.

Echo Mode uses smart algorithms and isokinetic training principles to keep the speed steady while recording your effort at every position. It learns your strength curve and ensures the eccentric loading matches your concentric effort, creating a force map that echos your best performance. No need to set reps or weight. Just push or pull and Echo does the rest. It is the ultimate training where you get out exactly what you put in.
The mirror allows you to see yourself while exercising. This helps you to ensure proper form and technique.

"Our non-adaptive mode. Old School applies constant resistance on the way up and down. No need to pause at the top or the bottom. The Trainer will 'spot' you and reduce the weight if you move below the bottom of your calibrated range-of-motion."
The force per cable will be increased after each rep.

Lift fast, then control the weight on the way down (eccentric phase). Lifting faster will get you closer to your selected force and lock it in for your eccentric phase. Lifting slower will reduces the force. Pump is perfect for those who want to feel the burn.
The force per cable will be reduced after each rep.

"Among the various training modes offered by Vitruvian, this one closely resembles traditional metal weight lifting. Its primary distinction lies in offering continuous tension throughout the exercise's range of motion, making it safer and more efficient in delivering results."
Resistance band applies additional weight over the range of the exercise, resembling how a band increases the effort required as you pass through easier parts of the exercise.

Rest is the time allocated for recovery between sets, within a workout. Proper rest between exercises is essential for optimizing performance, preventing fatigue-related injuries, and promoting overall workout effectiveness.
"Sound guidance gives real-time feedback on your reps and timer. With each sound, you'll know exactly where you are, even if your phone is out of reach."

" ""What do the Levels mean?
"" The Levels correspond to different speeds within Echo Mode. Generally speaking, the slower the speed, the harder the resistance will be. Try Epic out and see how hard it can get.
""What is the best way to use the Levels?
"" We would recommend picking a level based on the amount of reps you would like to complete, for example:
Hard: 10-15 reps Harder: 6-10 reps Hardest: 2-6 reps Epic: 1-3 reps
Higher reps are better for building fitness and muscle and often work better for smaller muscle groups. Lower reps are better for building strength, so choose a range that suits your goals. "
